cohort: The study included 60 American Society of Anaesthesiolgy (ASA) II pregnant patients planned for elective caesarean delivery under regional anaesthesia.
finding: Parturients with a baseline Perfusion Index (PI) > 3.5 were at a significantly higher risk of developing hypotension following a subarachnoid block compared to those with a baseline PI < 3.5.
gest_age: mean gestational age of 36.03+/-0.32 weeks (Group A) and 36.53+/-0.32 weeks (Group B)
